z-m-37-03.material: UMinjun wenza ibango eli: 'Kwiiseti A, B, C, A−(B∪C) = (A−B)∪(A−C) ihlala ibamba.' (A−B ifundwa 'umahluko wokususa u-B kwi-A'.) z-m-37-04.title: Yeyiphi intetho esisitatimenti esifanayo esibhalwe ngenye indlela?
z-m-37-04.topic: Ukukhetha iintetho zeeseti ezithetha okufanayo ne-'A yi-subset ye-B'
z-m-37-04.goal: Khetha iintetho ezithetha okufanayo ne-A⊂B, uze ubonise ngemizekelo emincinci ukuba iintetho ezingathethi okufanayo ziphosakala kweziphi iimeko.
z-m-37-04.material: Kwiiseti ezimbini A, B ngaphakathi kweseti yendalo yonke U, ufuna ukufumana iintetho ezithetha okufanayo ne-'A⊂B' (A yi-subset ye-B). A^c yi-'complement ye-A' (iseti efunyenwe ngokukhupha amalungu e-A kwi-U). Kwezi ntetho zintandathu ezingezantsi, zeziphi ezisoloko zithetha okufanayo ne-A⊂B?
